text_en: To the leader: according to Muth-labben. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官。调寄"木特拉本"。

text_en: I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
text_cn: 上主，我全心赞颂你， 宣扬你的一切奇伟；

text_en: I will be glad and exult in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
text_cn: 我要因你而欢欣踊跃， 歌颂你至高者的名号。

text_en: When my enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished before you.
text_cn: 因为我的仇敌已退藏， 在你面前已颠仆灭亡。

text_en: For you have maintained my just cause; you have sat on the throne giving righteous judgment.
text_cn: 你登上宝座，秉公行义， 为我审断了是非曲直。

text_en: You have rebuked the nations, you have destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name forever and ever.
text_cn: 你摧毁了异民，歼灭了恶徒， 你把他们的名字，永远消除。

text_en: The enemies have vanished in everlasting ruins; their cities you have rooted out; the very memory of them has perished.
text_cn: 敌人现已覆灭，永远沉沦， 你荡平的城邑，全不留名。

text_en: But the Lord sits enthroned forever, he has established his throne for judgment.
text_cn: 上主却为王于永远， 安置宝座秉公审判。

text_en: He judges the world with righteousness; he judges the peoples with equity.
text_cn: 将以公义审讯世人， 将以正直判决万民。

text_en: The Lord is a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
text_cn: 上主将是受迫害者的碉堡， 作他困厄中的及时避难所。

text_en: And those who know your name put their trust in you, for you, O Lord , have not forsaken those who seek you.
text_cn: 凡认识你名号的人，必仰望你， 上主，寻觅你的人，你必不摈弃。

text_en: Sing praises to the Lord , who dwells in Zion. Declare his deeds among the peoples.
text_cn: 你们该歌颂上主，他住在熙雍， 在万民中宣扬他的一切化工：

text_en: For he who avenges blood is mindful of them; he does not forget the cry of the afflicted.
text_cn: 上主追讨血债，常怀念悲苦的人民， 上主绝不会忘掉他们惨痛的呼声。

text_en: Be gracious to me, O Lord . See what I suffer from those who hate me; you are the one who lifts me up from the gates of death,
text_cn: 上主，求你怜悯我， 垂视我仇加于我的苦辱， 拯救我脱离死亡的门户，

text_en: so that I may recount all your praises, and, in the gates of daughter Zion, rejoice in your deliverance.
text_cn: 好使我在熙雍女子门口， 宣扬你的美誉， 欣享你的助佑。

text_en: The nations have sunk in the pit that they made; in the net that they hid has their own foot been caught.
text_cn: 异民都落于自己挖掘的深坑， 他们的脚都掉入自设的陷阱。

text_en: The Lord has made himself known, he has executed judgment; the wicked are snared in the work of their own hands. Higgaion. Selah
text_cn: 上主自显于世，行了审判， 恶人被自设的罗网所陷。琴声 （休止）

text_en: The wicked shall depart to Sheol, all the nations that forget God.
text_cn: 愿一般忘却天主的异族， 愿一般恶人都归于阴府！

text_en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
text_cn: 困苦的人绝不会被遗忘， 穷人的依靠永不会丧亡。

text_en: Rise up, O Lord ! Do not let mortals prevail; let the nations be judged before you.
text_cn: 上主，起来，莫让世人获胜， 愿异民尽都在你前受审！

text_en: Put them in fear, O Lord ; let the nations know that they are only human. Selah
text_cn: 上主，恳请你恐吓异民， 使他们自知不过是人。 （休止）
